definitions.exact_match_function_level: Percentage of generated patches that are character-by-character identical to the human-written target fix at function level (E-M). Higher is better.
definitions.success_rate_function_level: Percentage of generated patches that are semantically equivalent to the human-written target fix (Succ). Includes exact matches. Higher is better.
definitions.failure_rate_function_level: Percentage of generated patches not semantically equivalent to the human fix (Fail = 100% - Succ%). Lower is better.
definitions.exact_match_cve_level: Percentage of CVEs where ALL function-level patches are exact matches. Higher is better.
definitions.success_rate_cve_level: Percentage of CVEs where ALL function-level patches are successes. Higher is better.
definitions.code_bleu: Code-aware BLEU score (0-1) for failed patches measuring token-level similarity to the human fix. Higher is better. Use sacrebleu or a CodeBLEU implementation.

reporting_format.note: Report results in a table with columns: Method | E-M (%) | Succ (%) | Fail (%) | C-B
reporting_format.group_by: Report separately for function-level and CVE-level if both are computed

evaluation_script_hint: Use sacrebleu for BLEU: `pip install sacrebleu`. For CodeBLEU, use https://github.com/microsoft/CodeBLEU or implement the weighted combination of BLEU + AST match + data flow match for C code using tree-sitter.
